title: Vite, Rollup, and Rolldown lifecycle contract map
purpose: Map Rollup and Rolldown lifecycle contracts independently, then reconcile them against Vite before proposing further compatibility or policy changes.
exclusions: No implementation changes during A001 or A002.
No promotion of Rollup or Rolldown to recurring targets without continuing independent work.
No broad scheduler or multi-error policy proposal presented as a compatibility repair.

constraints.default_time_boundary: Produce a bounded contract map and ranked next questions; stop before speculative implementation.

questions: What lifecycle contract does Rollup document, implement, and test?
Which Rollup-compatible lifecycle behaviors does Rolldown implement or intentionally differ from?
Where does Vite match, adapt, or diverge from those contracts?

assignments.source_revision: Pin exact master SHA at claim time; retrieval boundary 2026-08-05 or later.
assignments.question: What lifecycle, scheduling, argument, watch, shutdown, and outward-error contracts does Rollup document, implement, and test?
assignments.claim_to_support_or_falsify: Rollup supplies a concrete lifecycle contract that can be used as the first comparison boundary for Vite plugin behavior.
preferred_primary_sources: Rollup source at the claimed exact revision
assignments.deliverable: Lifecycle diagram, exact source and test map, error and scheduling table, negative results, and ranked comparison questions.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop after the contract map is sufficient for comparison, or record blocked/unknown semantics that cannot be established from public source and tests.

assignments.source_revision: Pin exact main SHA at claim time; retrieval boundary 2026-08-05 or later.
assignments.question: Which Rollup-compatible lifecycle behaviors does Rolldown implement, test, intentionally differ from, or leave incomplete?
assignments.claim_to_support_or_falsify: Rolldown exposes an observable compatibility surface that Vite lifecycle work must consider alongside Rollup.
preferred_primary_sources: Rolldown source at the claimed exact revision
Rolldown public types and compatibility layers
assignments.deliverable: Compatibility matrix, exact source and test map, deliberate deviations, migration hazards, negative results, and ranked Vite questions.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop after observable compatibility behavior and known gaps are mapped, or record a blocked result where public evidence is insufficient.

assignments.source_revision: Pin exact default-branch SHA after A001 and A002 handoffs are accepted.
assignments.question: Where does Vite match, adapt, or diverge from Rollup and Rolldown lifecycle contracts, and which differences deserve bounded follow-up?
assignments.claim_to_support_or_falsify: A Vite lifecycle difference can be classified as shared contract, intentional adaptation, plausible compatibility defect, or separate policy proposal.
preferred_primary_sources: Vite source at the claimed exact revision
assignments.deliverable: Vite compatibility matrix, exact call-site and test map, one bounded probe or explicit feasibility limit, ranked next investigations, and target-promotion recommendation.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop after differences are classified and bounded next questions are ranked; do not implement or contact upstream.
